content: Babiloone Gimbe
Sa7a bolla de7iya asi ubbay koyro issi doonan odetees.
Enti doloha baggafe dendidi bida wode Sana7oora biittan demba bessi demmidi yan uttidosona.
Enti issoy issuwako, “Haa yiite, xuube medhidi, minnana mela taman xuuggoos” yaagidosona. Enti shucha gisho xuube, urqa gisho made melaba,
ekidi, “Haa yiite, nu sunthaa xeegisanawunne qassi nuuni ha sa7a bolla laaletonna attana mela issi gita katamaanne xeeray salo gakiya pooqe keexoos” yaagidosona.
Shin Goday asati keexida gita katamaanne pooqiya be7anaw duge wodhis.
Goday haysada yaagis; “Heko, enti issi asi; enti ubbayka issi doonan odetidosona. Enti ha7i haysa oothanaw doomidosona. Enti bantaw oothanaw halchidaba polonna aggokona.
Yaaniya gisho, haayite; duge wodhidi enti issoy haasayiya doona issoy eronna mela enta doona dummayos” yaagis.
Goday enta hessafe sa7a ubbaa bolla laallin, enti katama keexeysa aggaagidosona.
Goday sa7an de7iya asa doona yan buqida gisho he katamaa sunthay Babiloone
geetetis. Goday enta hessafe sa7a ubbaa bolla laallis.
Seema Yeletetha
Seema yeletethay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa; dhayo haathaafe guye, nam7u laythi gidin, Seemas laythi xeeta gidida wode, Seemi Arfakisaade yelis.
Seemi Arfakisaade yelidaape guye, ichashu xeetu laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Arfakisaadi 35 laythi de7idi, Salaha yelis.
Arfakisaadi Saala yelidaape guye, 403 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Saali 30 laythi de7idi, Eboora yelis.
Saali Eboora yelidaape guye, 403 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Eboori 34 laythi de7idi, Pelega yelis.
Eboori Pelega yelidaape guye, 430 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Pelegi 30 laythi de7idi, Ra7a yelis.
Pelegi Ra7a yelidaape guye 209 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Ra7i 32 laythi de7idi, Saruga yelis.
Ra7i Saruga yelidaape guye, 207 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Sarugi 30 laythi de7idi, Nakoora yelis.
Sarugi Nakoora yelidaape guye, 200 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Nakoori 29 laythi de7idi, Taara yelis.
Nakoori Taara yelidaape guye, 119 laythi de7is. Hara adde naytanne macca nayta yelis.
Taari 70 laythi de7idi, Abrame, Nakooranne Haarane yelis.
Taara Yeletetha
Taara yeletethay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa; Taari Abrame, Nakooranne Haarane yelis. Yaatin Haraani Looxe yelis.
Haraani ba aaway Taari paxa de7ishin, ba yeletida Kaldaaweta biittan, gita Uure kataman hayqis.
Abrameynne Naakorey nam7ayka machidosona. Abrame mache sunthay Soora. Qassi Nakoora mache sunthay Milko. Milka Haarana na7iw; Haaraney Milkanne Yosika aawa.
Soora maynthi gidida gisho iw na7i baawa.
Taari ba na7aa Abrame, ba na7aa Haarane na7aa Looxenne, ba na7aa Abrame machiw Soora ekidi, Kanaane biitta baanaw Kaldaaweta katamaa Uurepe dendis. Shin enti Kaarane katama gakidi yan uttidosona.
Taari 205 laythi de7idi Kaaranen hayqis.
